info.name: Meal Planner API - Ingredient shopping
info.description: Importable Postman Collection v2.1. No authentication. Set base_url and run folders 01-06 in order. Response scripts capture IDs automatically. All unit codes are English. Requires the November 21 measurement and English-unit migrations plus seeded reference data. Requests create demo records, update a selected menu and generate the next weekly menu. Optional folders 07 and 08 cover errors and cleanup. No requests were executed when this collection was generated.

item.name: 01 - Reference data
item.description: Run first to capture meal-type IDs. Unit codes and technical labels are English; Accept-Language localizes errors, not codes.

exec: pm.test("Unit codes use English identifiers", function () {

item.name: List meal types and capture IDs
02 - Create demonstration ingredients
item.description: Creates three ingredients with a unique run suffix and captures their IDs. Running the first request again starts a new set of demonstration records.

item.name: 03 - Ingredient measurement references
item.description: Independent from buying presentations. PUT/PATCH replace the complete reference set; an empty array clears it. Factors here are explicitly synthetic demonstration data.

request.description: 13 g per 15 ml. The single ratio derives teaspoons, tablespoons and cups using the global standard.

item.name: 04 - Habitual buying presentations
item.description: Each ingredient has one habitual presentation. Package contents may use g, kg, ml, l or piece. No density is required just to save a presentation.

item.name: 05 - Recipes
item.description: Run the first folder beforehand to populate meal-type IDs. A single occurrence for one person needs 130 g mayonnaise, 2.4 onions (displayed as 3), and two 140 g cans of tuna. Weekly totals depend on which recipes are actually scheduled.

item.name: Create recipe and capture its ID
Update recipe servings without replacing ingredients

request.description: Halves the recipe requirements per person; stored quantities and can contents remain unchanged.

item.name: 06 - Menus and shopping list
item.description: List menus selects the most recent menu; you may set menu_id manually instead. Generation replaces the next Monday-Sunday menu and captures its new ID. Generation requires enough classified recipes and does not guarantee selection of the demonstration recipe. This collection does not modify scheduling logic.

item.description: Run only when finished with the demonstration records. Deleting the demo recipe also removes its assignments from menus. Ingredient deletion requires removing its recipe first. This folder is included if you run the entire collection.
